as_of.description: the store's as-of date, YYYY-MM-DD, or empty

summary.description: a plain-words answer that only restates the tags below

reason.description: the reason exactly as the tool returned it, or empty

condition.description: the condition, as the rule states it

value.description: the customer's value, exactly as the tool returned it

needs.description: what the condition needed, for example 'at least 6'

refusal_reason.description: which rule a refused request broke, or empty

outputSchema.description: the agent's answer: only facts the read-only tools returned

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: The tag taxonomy: every tag's rule in words, the data it reads, its limitations, and the intended and prohibited uses. Read-only. Never use for credit, pricing, fraud or AML decisions, or any automated decision with legal or similarly significant effect.

exclusive_group.description: empty when the tag is in no exclusive group

intended_use.description: what tags may be used for

prohibited_uses.description: what tags must never be used for

tools.name: get_customer_tags
tools.description: One customer's current tags, each with its reason, rule, every condition's evidence and its as-of date, plus suppressed and not-evaluated tags and data notes. Read-only. Never use for credit, pricing, fraud or AML decisions, or any automated decision with legal or similarly significant effect.

reason.description: the reason in plain words, filled from the evidence

entered_on.description: first month-end check of the current run, or empty if new this month

since_window_start.description: held since the start of the kept history

display.description: the value as shown to staff

available.description: false when the value could not be computed

items.description: one condition of the rule: what was measured, against what, and the result
